newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close lower before US labor data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close lower before US labor data.

text.p: Feb 6 - U.S. debt futures closed lower, as traders and dealers squared positions ahead of Friday's U.S. labor data for January. Payrolls are seen falling to 237,000, vs 262,000 in Dec. Avg hourly earnings are seen up 0.2 pct, vs up 0.5 pct. The unemployment rate is forecast to fall to 5.2 pct, vs 5.3 pct.
